topic: The umbrella that is always forgotten at home on rainy days.

episode.title: The Umbrella Everyone Forgets

shots.narration: I'm an umbrella, and apparently my job is staying dry.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon modern entryway, closed front door, rain visible through a narrow window, no text or logos.
shots.action: A folded yellow umbrella with big expressive eyes and a small disappointed mouth points its curved handle toward the rain.
shots.mood: Cosy warm interior contrasted with a rainy blue outdoors.

shots.narration: Every morning, I wait right beside the door.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon entryway, umbrella stand directly beside the front door, plain shoes below, no text or logos.
shots.action: The folded yellow umbrella with big expressive eyes and a small hopeful mouth leans toward the doorway.
shots.mood: Eager anticipation, cheerful yellow against soft pastel walls.

shots.narration: [sighs] They remember keys, shoes, and absolutely not me.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon entryway, open front door revealing wet pavement, umbrella stand beside the threshold, no text or logos.
shots.action: The front door swings shut beside the folded yellow umbrella with big expressive eyes and a small stunned mouth.
shots.mood: Comic abandonment, grey daylight shrinking behind the door.

shots.narration: Then the rain starts showing off.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon entryway beside a tall window streaked with heavy rain, no text or logos.
shots.action: The folded yellow umbrella with big expressive eyes and a small envious mouth presses its face against the window.
shots.mood: Dramatic rainy blue light, exaggerated longing.

shots.narration: Look at that weather. That's my entire skill set.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon entryway, rain-filled window behind an umbrella stand, no text or logos.
shots.action: The yellow umbrella with big expressive eyes and a small determined mouth springs open inside the stand.
shots.mood: Heroic pose in a comically ordinary hallway.

shots.narration: [sarcastic] Meanwhile, I'm protecting the hallway from absolutely nothing.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon entryway, open yellow umbrella above a spotless dry floor, no text or logos.
shots.action: The open yellow umbrella with big expressive eyes and a small unimpressed mouth tilts toward the dry floor.
shots.mood: Quiet absurdity, warm lighting and conspicuously dry surroundings.

shots.narration: They finally remember me when the puddles come home.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon entryway, wet muddy boots resting on a plain doormat beside the open yellow umbrella, no text or logos.
shots.action: Water drips from the boots beside the open yellow umbrella with big expressive eyes and a small horrified mouth.
shots.mood: Messy homecoming, glossy puddles on a clean floor.

shots.narration: Now I'm ready for tomorrow, right by the exit.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon entryway, closed front door, folded yellow umbrella standing on a plain brown doormat, no text or logos.
shots.action: The folded yellow umbrella with big expressive eyes and a small determined mouth wedges its curved handle beneath the door lever.
shots.mood: Triumphant preparation, bright hopeful morning light.

shots.narration: [chuckles] If they forget me again, the doormat gets custody.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon entryway, plain brown doormat beneath the door lever, no text or logos.
shots.action: The folded yellow umbrella with big expressive eyes and a small cheeky smile topples onto the muddy doormat.
shots.mood: Playful defeat, cosy lighting and a muddy landing.

episode.endHook: Next episode: the doormat has some dirty laundry to share.
episode.description: I'm ready for rain. Unfortunately, my human only remembers me after getting soaked. An umbrella shares its very dry side of a rainy day.
